summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 4 new features (Reports page, Decision Override, PDF Preview, Live AI Memo toggle) plus regression. 17/17 backend pytest tests pass (added TestReports, TestOverride, TestDecisionUseAi). Full frontend E2E on the preview URL passed: Reports renders KPIs + 4 charts; Override dialog opens on Sri Lakshmi, blocks empty reason, applies override (banner+audit event), persists across reload, and Re-run Decision clears override; PDF preview shows friendly toast for seeded doc (no crash) and renders iframe for uploaded PDF; AI memo toggle OFF => 'Deterministic template draft', ON => 'Drafted by AI · gpt-5.4' (real LLM ~30s). No blockers.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing `DialogDescription`/`aria-describedby` (PDF preview + override dialog) — console warning only, accessibility nit.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add a <DialogDescription> (or aria-describedby) to PDF preview dialog and override dialog to remove Radix a11y warning.
OPTIONAL (from iter1): Move `if (user) navigate('/dashboard')` in Login.js into a useEffect to eliminate React setState-in-render warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py override endpoint returns 422 (pydantic) for empty reason — good. Consider mapping to a 400 with a user-friendly message for API clients; the UI already guards client-side so not blocking.
runDecision replaces the decision doc completely, correctly clearing override — verified.

AuditTab hides payload behind an expand toggle, so the `reason` for a Decision Overridden event is not visible until expanded. Consider surfacing the reason inline for override events (audit view now shows only the event title).
server.py is 740+ lines with routers all in one file — split into modules for maintainability (unchanged from iter1).
generate_ai_memo hardcodes model 'openai/gpt-5.4' — works with current Emergent key; verified live.
seed_data_creation: Idempotent POST /api/demo/seed. Uploaded a small PDF to BluePeak Traders during testing. One TEST_ borrower app created via pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers reports summary structure, override (empty reason 422, success + audit from/to/reason payload, persistence via GET, re-run clears override), and use_ai=false template memo. Live LLM (use_ai=true) verified only via UI to avoid slow pytests; badge in MemoTab correctly reflects memo_source. Sri Lakshmi Components was left in an overridden->rerun state (fresh REVIEW decision, no override) at end of run.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing issues; only accessibility warnings and a minor UX note about audit reason visibility.
